messages.author: 28f7cf43544f2467
messages.subject: Facet Ribbon Size
parts:
Is there a way to control the width of the bars/ribbons placed at the
top of each facet when using facet_wrap()?

I'd like to shrink the width if possible to lend more room to the
graphs.

Thanks in advance for any advice.

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Facet Ribbon Size
parts:
Hi Nick,

Do you mean the height? The width is always the same as the panel width.

Hadley
